post.caption: Sixteen years of Today's the day. The Spanish ship Atocha sank in a hurricane in September 1622. Mel Fisher began searching for it in 1969, and his saying was Today's the day. In 1971, diver Don Kincaid brought up about eight feet of gold chain. The main pile was found on July 20, 1985, about 35 miles west of Key West. The haul was more than 40 tons of gold and silver, and it included an uncut Colombian emerald of about 77 carats. The finds are kept in the Mel Fisher museum in Key West.
